rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [LOGIC] gen:TRF005Shape/sh:or[2]: The non-applicable-date branch can conform even when nltl:applicableIceClassRegulationEdition is nltl:iceClassRegulationEdition2002, because its SPARQL constraint checks only whether the dates meet the applicability condition and does not reject selection of the 2002 edition outside that condition. Required change: In the non-applicable branch, require that nltl:applicableIceClassRegulationEdition is absent or is not nltl:iceClassRegulationEdition2002, while preserving the existing date-condition check. | [COMPLETENESS] gen:TRF005Shape: The candidate never references nltl:iceClass, although the requirement declares iceClass as the required input and anchor variable. Required change: Add nltl:iceClass as a required input to the target ship constraint, without inventing an additional ice-class value restriction.

[LOGIC] gen:TRF005Shape/sh:or branch 2/sh:sparql: The inapplicable-date branch does not reject a ship that has nltl:applicableIceClassRegulationEdition nltl:iceClassRegulationEdition2002. Its query only reports a violation when the applicability condition is true and the 2002 edition is absent, so the overall sh:or accepts the 2002 edition even when the construction dates fall outside the stated applicability condition. Required change: Add an explicit violation for the inapplicable case when the 2002 edition is present, or otherwise encode the conditional as an exclusive equivalence: the 2002 edition must be present exactly when constructionStageDate is on or after 2003-09-01 and constructionContractDate is before 2010-01-01.
No concrete blocking defect detected in the current candidate.
